text: Basic wages and wage payment. General wage entitlement and payment rules excluding changing regional rate amounts.
Exact regional minimum-wage amounts. Current peso rates depend on region, sector, category, tranche, and current wage orders.
Hours of work. Basic rules on compensable working time and ordinary hours.
Rest days. Basic weekly rest-day rights and related rules.
Overtime pay. Basic overtime entitlement and premium rules.
Holiday and premium pay. Basic holiday, special-day, and premium-pay rules within the available current sources.
Thirteenth-month pay. Coverage, timing, and basic computation principles supported by verified authorities.
Basic employment-contract concerns. Basic private-sector contract and employment-status concerns within the verified sources.
Termination and procedural due process. Basic just or authorized causes and procedural notice requirements.
Final pay and certificate of employment. Basic final-pay and certificate-of-employment guidance.
Labor complaints and referrals. Basic SEnA and agency-routing information.
Overseas Filipino workers. Overseas employment is governed by specialized institutions and rules.
Seafarers. Seafarer employment and disability disputes require specialized sources.
Government employees. Government employment is generally governed by civil-service rules.
Kasambahays. Domestic workers are covered by specialized legislation not included in the initial module.
Union elections and complex collective bargaining. Complex union representation and collective-bargaining matters
Workers' compensation and disability. Benefits and disability computations require specialized sources and factual review.
Occupational-safety compliance. Detailed occupational-safety compliance is outside the initial scope.
Retirement and pension computations. Retirement and social-insurance computations require additional laws and current data.
Pending labor cases. The system does not assess or intervene in pending proceedings.
Personalized case-outcome prediction. The system must not predict whether a user will win or lose.
General consumer-law framework. Short title, policy, construction, coverage, and other general provisions that provide context but may not independently establish a remedy.
Defective products. Basic rights and remedies involving defective consumer products.
Product warranties. Basic express and implied warranty concerns supported by verified sources.
Repair, replacement, and refund. Available consumer remedies within the verified scope.
Deceptive or unfair sales practices. Basic deceptive, unfair, or unconscionable sales practices.
Misleading advertisements. Basic false or misleading advertising concerns.
Price tags and displayed prices. Displayed-price and exact-change concerns.
Product safety. General consumer-product safety concerns within DTI jurisdiction.
Basic service complaints. General consumer-service complaints within DTI jurisdiction.
Ordinary online consumer transactions. Covered business-to-consumer internet transactions under the Internet Transactions Act and Consumer Act.
DTI complaint procedure and referrals. Basic mediation, adjudication, and no-wrong-door referral information.
Banking, lending, and credit-card disputes. Financial consumer disputes require specialized banking and credit authorities.
Insurance. Insurance disputes require specialized law and regulation.
Investments and securities. Investment and securities disputes
Telecommunications. Telecommunications service disputes require current sector-specific regulation.
Data privacy. Privacy complaints require the Data Privacy Act and NPC materials.
Medical malpractice. Medical negligence requires specialized legal and factual assessment.
Real-estate transactions. Real-estate sales and housing regulation require specialized sources.
Transportation regulation. Passenger and transport disputes may fall under specialized regulators.
Utility billing. Electricity and water billing are governed by specialized regulators.
Online fraud requiring criminal investigation. Potential criminal scams require law-enforcement and specialized investigation.
